mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for deck lighting installation in Alameda?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for deck lighting installation can vary by specific city regulations, including within our service area such as Alameda. Generally, low-voltage lighting systems may not require a permit, but any new electrical circuit or significant electrical work might. We can assist in determining if permits are necessary for your project and guide you through the application process if required by local building codes.
